verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a Virtual Solo reader that works with a sandbox merchant account, so developers can test Cloud API pairing and checkout end-to-end before switching to a physical reader. The docs also cover preparing a merchant account, device, and integration for testing. Missing for 10: evidence of simulated-reader or test-card testing for the Reader SDK and Payment Switch paths, documented in-person failure/decline scenario simulation (the test cards cited are for online payments), and independent hands-on corroboration.
